name: RecordEditor
purpose: A generic view/edit/save/cancel/delete workflow with explicit record versions and retained failure drafts.
description: Generic record workflow. Hosts must enforce expectedVersion atomically at their persistence boundary.

props.name: createDraft
props.description: Return an independent editable snapshot. The pattern never guesses how to clone domain objects.

props.name: defaultEditing
props.description: Initial mode only; changing this prop does not reset an active session.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Resolve with the authoritative saved record/version; reject to retain the draft.

guidance.overview: A generic view/edit/save/cancel/delete workflow with explicit record versions and retained failure drafts.
usage: Supply an independent createDraft function and equality comparator for your domain.
Resolve onSave with the authoritative saved record and new version; reject on validation or persistence failure.
Enforce expectedVersion atomically and honor AbortSignal where possible.
Guard recordId changes externally when an active draft must not be discarded.
accessibility: Use meaningful names and preserve the shared control keyboard behavior.
Verify the real host integration, including focus and recovery, with keyboard and assistive technology.
intent: Coordinate a generic record viewing and editing session with an independent draft, asynchronous save/delete and explicit version conflicts.
context: No backend, authorization, autosave, undo, merge algorithm or automatic router guard.
The host must enforce optimistic concurrency on the server or other authoritative persistence boundary.
Record identity changes intentionally reset the session; same-version record changes violate the host version contract.
Native fieldset disabling does not disable portaled controls; renderFields.disabled is provided for that boundary.
